newsitem.title: UK: Amey up after UK newspaper recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Amey up after UK newspaper recommendation.

text.p: Shares in UK civil engineering group Amey Plc rose on Monday after a recommendation in the Sunday Times "Inside Track" column, dealers said.
The stock was up 18p at 423 by 0926 GMT.

The column set a price target of 600p on the stock and said Amey was on course for a pre-tax profit of 11 million stg in 1996 and 15 million in 1997, putting it on a multiple of 13 times current-year earnings at Friday's close of 405p.
It said that earnings prospects were improving as the company wins contracts under the government's Private Finance Initiative (PFI).
Noting that Amey had recently been awarded a contract to build a three-lane motorway linking the M6 and M74 motorways, the column said it was likely to win further PFI contracts.
